title: Smart health
desc: A comprehensive healthcare management and online pharmacy solution.
longDesc: SmartHealth is a cutting-edge vibe coding application designed as a comprehensive online pharmacy and healthcare management solution. It allows users to manage their prescriptions entirely online and consult with licensed pharmacists 24/7 via secure chat. The application features an advanced AI prescription analyzer and an intelligent chat widget to streamline patient care. Built for affordability, the platform accepts major insurance plans and offers same-day local delivery for critical medications. By merging cutting-edge biological science with premium product design, it provides an intuitive environment for optimizing daily vitality and well-being.

title: Pizzapoint
desc: A dedicated platform for pizza ordering with real-time tracking.
longDesc: PizzaPoint is a dedicated e-commerce platform specifically built for seamless pizza ordering and delivery in Rangpur. The application features a 'build your own' tool that lets customers pick their preferred base, sauce, cheese, and vegetables. It includes a live order tracking system that monitors the pizza's progress from the kitchen directly to the user's door. The platform maintains a close track of ingredient inventory to ensure that all customizable options are always available for fulfillment. With its responsive design and localized focus, PizzaPoint provides a modern solution for fast-food delivery services.

title: Reciply
desc: A modern recipe discovery and sharing community for food lovers.
longDesc: Recipely is a modern full-stack recipe discovery community developed to connect food lovers and home cooks worldwide. It provides a clean minimalist interface where users can search, explore, and save their favorite culinary creations. The platform features advanced filtering by category, cuisine, and difficulty to help users find exactly what they want to cook. Premium membership options are available, allowing users to upload unlimited recipes and access exclusive content via Stripe integration. By implementing secure JWT authentication and real-time social features, Recipely offers a trustworthy environment for building a digital kitchen notebook.

title: SportNest
desc: A modern sports facility management and equipment platform.
longDesc: SportNest is a modern standard platform for sports facility management and gear e-commerce designed for athletes. It streamlines booking operations for turfs and courts, allowing players to secure slots instantly without needing phone calls. The system features an automated schedule tracker that guarantees zero overlapping or double-bookings by showing real-time availability. Users can manage their active game schedules and view digital booking receipts through an all-in-one personal dashboard. Built with Next.js and MongoDB, it leverages server-side rendering to provide a fast and SEO-friendly user experience.

title: Qurbani Hat
desc: A premium livestock booking platform for Eid-ul-Adha.
longDesc: Qurbani Hat is a full-featured web application designed to connect users with premium livestock for the Eid-ul-Adha festival. The platform allows users to browse various animals with detailed specifications such as price, weight, and breed category. It features a secure booking system powered by Better Auth, ensuring that all transactions and user data remain protected. The application provides real-time availability updates for every listing to prevent booking conflicts during the busy festival season. With its mobile-first design and intuitive user dashboard, it offers the smartest way to manage religious sacrifice arrangements.

title: The Dragon News
desc: A real-time news portal with category filtering and bookmarks.
longDesc: The Dragon News is a comprehensive news portal built to provide journalism without fear or favor. It features category-based news filtering across international, sports, and entertainment sections to keep readers informed. The application includes a real-time news marquee ticker for breaking headlines and supports secure social authentication for personalized access. Users can sign in via Google or GitHub to bookmark important articles and enjoy a clean, ad-free reading experience. Utilizing Next.js and MongoDB, the portal handles large volumes of content while maintaining high performance on all devices.

title: Keen Keeper
desc: A friendship management app to track and maintain relationships.
longDesc: Keen Keeper is a beautiful friendship management web application created to help users maintain meaningful social relationships. It allows users to track their interaction status with friends through real-time indicators like 'On Track' or 'Overdue'. The application features a chronological interaction timeline that logs every call, text, or meetup with timestamped history. An integrated analytics dashboard powered by Recharts provides visual insights into social habits and communication patterns. Built with React 19 and Vite, it offers a fast and responsive interface with support for both dark and light modes.

title: Hero Io
desc: An application discovery platform for exploring web solutions.
longDesc: Hero IO is an interactive web solution developed to serve as a discovery platform for exploring various applications. The project utilizes modern React features such as context state management to provide a seamless navigation experience. Users can browse a grid of applications and view detailed pages for each tool to understand its functionality. The layout is designed to be fully responsive, ensuring accessibility across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices. With its clean UI and lightweight structure, Hero IO demonstrates efficient frontend development practices using Vite and React.

title: Book Vibe
desc: A vibrant book collection platform to track your reading progress.
longDesc: Book Vibe is a vibrant book collection platform designed to help readers discover and track their favorite literary works. Users can browse a curated selection of books, read detailed reviews, and maintain a personal reading list. The application includes a reading progress tracker that allows users to save titles for later and manage their wishlist effectively. Built entirely with React and Tailwind CSS, it offers a smooth single-page application experience with fast transitions. The responsive layout ensures that the entire book catalog is easily accessible for book lovers on any device.

title: g3-architect-website
desc: A modern architectural portfolio for the G3 Architect group.
longDesc: The G3 Architect Website is a modern portfolio showcase created for a brand-new group of professional architects. It features a clean architectural layout that highlights professional designs and completed projects through high-quality visual sections. The site includes a dedicated facts section that displays credible statistics about awards won, projects finished, and clients served. Built with HTML5 and CSS3, the project is optimized for fast loading and provides a mobile-first user experience. The design includes a quick list of features and a sponsors section to establish industry authority for the firm.

title: Digtools platfrom
desc: A React-based platform for buying AI-powered digital tools.
longDesc: DigTools Platform is a React-based e-commerce solution specifically designed for browsing and purchasing premium AI digital tools. It features a dynamic product grid where information is fetched from external JSON data using the latest React use() hook. The application includes a real-time shopping cart with duplicate prevention alerts and automatic total price calculation. Users can toggle between a high-density product view and a dedicated cart management view using a sophisticated tabbed layout. With its fully responsive design and professional loading spinners, the platform provides a smooth checkout flow for digital tool seekers.

title: github issu traker
desc: A tool to track and manage GitHub repository issues.
longDesc: The GitHub Issue Tracker is a specialized utility tool developed to manage and track repository issues through a centralized interface. Users can sign in with administrative credentials to access a secure dashboard for overseeing project tasks and bugs. The application utilizes GitHub APIs to fetch and sync data directly from repositories in real-time. It is designed to simplify the developer workflow by organizing open issues and their current resolution status. This project serves as a functional tool for teams looking to streamline their issue management process efficiently.

title: Tree store
desc: An online plant store focused on environmental sustainability.
longDesc: Tree Store is an online plant storefront dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability through the purchase of various trees. The platform features an extensive catalog of fruit-bearing and flowering trees with detailed specifications on growth and benefits. Each listing provides information about climate requirements and nutritional value to help home gardeners make informed choices. Users can filter products by category and manage their selections through an interactive shopping cart system. This project supports a global mission to plant one million trees and create a greener future for coming generations.

title: English janala
desc: An interactive web-based English learning platform for beginners.
longDesc: English Janala is an interactive web-based learning platform designed to help beginners improve their English skills in an engaging way. The project focuses on providing structured, beginner-friendly lessons that cover essential vocabulary and basic grammar. It features a clean UI where students can practice exercises and explore an FAQ section for technical or language-related questions. The platform includes a simple authentication interface to track individual user progress and provide a personalized journey. Overall, the goal of English Janala is to make language education accessible and intuitive for learners at all levels.

title: Job traket
desc: A career management tool to organize job applications.
longDesc: Job Tracker is a simple yet effective application designed to help job seekers organize their career mission by tracking applications. The interface provides a clear overview of available jobs and allows users to categorize them into sections like interviews or rejections. It features a clean UI with descriptions for each role, including requirements for technologies like React and Node.js. Job seekers can manage their search status and view detailed information such as salary ranges and company locations directly on the platform. Built with JavaScript DOM manipulation, the project handles dynamic updates to the job lists and status indicators.

title: pyoo bank
desc: A banking interface for secure digital financial management.
longDesc: Payoo Bank is a fintech-oriented banking interface designed to provide a secure environment for digital financial management. The application features a robust login system that validates user credentials before granting access to personal account dashboards. Users can perform various banking operations through the interface, including viewing balance information and managing transactions. The frontend is built using HTML and JavaScript with a focus on responsiveness to ensure the platform works on all screens. It also includes error handling logic to return specific feedback for invalid transaction amounts, ensuring data integrity.

title: Tea house
desc: A responsive single-page website for a premium tea supplier.
longDesc: The Tea House is a modern and elegant single-page website created for a premium supplier of tea and botanical solutions. It showcases a wide array of products including Milk Tea, Black Tea, and unique Green Tea blends for diverse tastes. The platform highlights the brand's commitment to quality by detailing the history and origins of their specialized tea services. Visitors can explore client testimonials, browse upcoming news and events, and subscribe to a newsletter for regular updates. Built with Tailwind CSS and HTML, the site is fully responsive and features smooth scrolling for a premium experience.

title: Tach wave
desc: A hub for tech insights, productivity hacks, and podcast episodes.
longDesc: TechWave is a technology-focused platform and podcast hub providing a daily dose of tech insights and productivity hacks. The site serves as a central repository for over 200 published episodes featuring interviews with industry leaders and startup founders. Users can access rich resources for every episode, including detailed show notes, transcripts, and additional learning materials. The platform is designed to be mobile-friendly, allowing a global community of listeners from over 120 countries to stay updated. Its clean interface emphasizes the discovery of trending tech topics like the future of AI and remote work strategies.

title: Knowledge-Vault
desc: A centralized personal knowledge management system.
longDesc: Knowledge Vault is a centralized learning hub designed to act as a 'second brain' for managing development notes and tutorials. The platform allows users to capture ideas with a built-in structure from day one, turning scattered notes into an interconnected web. It features a clean and scalable folder system that organizes knowledge storage by topics and resources for easy navigation. Built with a focus on productivity, it helps learners think more clearly by connecting related concepts automatically as they write. This project is ideal for developers and students who need a single source of truth for their evolving technical skills.
